summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting notices and consents extending the outside date for its previously announced $24.0 million private placement of common stock from September 29, 2026 to October 16, 2026. The purchasers' funding deadline and related termination rights were similarly extended, and the company may defer and coordinate closings per purchaser until conditions are satisfied. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The purchase agreement otherwise remains unchanged. Watch for timely satisfaction of closing conditions, any further extensions, and dilution or financing risk if the placement fails to close.
